metadata.title: Broken Replica Symmetry Bounds in the Mean Field Spin Glass Model

nodes.name: Hamiltonian of the mean field spin glass model
nodes.statement: The Hamiltonian is $H_N(\sigma,h,J)=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\sum_{(i,j)}J_{ij}\sigma_i\sigma_j-h\sum_{i}\sigma_i$, with Ising spins $\sigma_i=\pm 1$ and i.i.d. centered unit Gaussians $J_{ij}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Sherrington-Kirkpatrick mean field Hamiltonian for $N$ Ising spins with Gaussian disorder and external field $h$.

nodes.name: Partition function and quenched free energy
nodes.statement: $Z_N(\beta,h,J)=\sum_{\sigma}\exp(-\beta H_N(\sigma,h,J))$ and $-\beta f_N(\beta,h)=N^{-1} E\log Z_N(\beta,h,J)=\alpha_N(\beta,h)$, with Boltzmann state $\omega_J(A)=Z_N^{-1}\sum_\sigma A\,e^{-\beta H_N}$.

nodes.name: Replica overlap
nodes.statement: For replicas $a,b$ with spin variables $\sigma_i^{(a)},\sigma_i^{(b)}$ drawn from the product state $\Omega_J=\omega_J^{(1)}\cdots\omega_J^{(s)}$, the overlap is $q_{ab}=N^{-1}\sum_i \sigma_i^{(a)}\sigma_i^{(b)}$, with $-1\le q_{ab}\le 1$.

nodes.name: Functional order parameter $x$
nodes.statement: The convex space $\mathcal{X}$ consists of nondecreasing functions $x:[0,1]\to[0,1]$, $q\mapsto x(q)$, equipped with the $L^1([0,1],dq)$ norm.

nodes.name: Piecewise constant order parameter
nodes.statement: An $x\in\mathcal{X}$ characterized by $0=q_0\le q_1\le\dots\le q_K=1$ and $0\le m_1\le\dots\le m_K\le 1$ with $x(q)=m_a$ on $[q_{a-1},q_a)$; we set $m_0\equiv 0$, $m_{K+1}\equiv 1$. The replica symmetric case is $K=2$, $q_1=\bar q$, $m_1=0$, $m_2=1$.

nodes.name: Antiparabolic equation defining $f(q,y;x,\beta)$
nodes.statement: $f$ solves $(\partial_q f)+\frac{1}{2}(f''+x(q)(f')^{2})=0$ with final condition $f(1,y)=\log\cosh(\beta y)$, where $f'=\partial_y f$, $f''=\partial_y^2 f$.

nodes.name: Trial auxiliary function $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$
nodes.statement: $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)\equiv \log 2 + f(0,h;x,\beta)-\frac{\beta^2}{2}\int_0^1 q\,x(q)\,dq$.

nodes.name: Parisi spontaneously broken replica symmetry solution $\bar\alpha(\beta,h)$
nodes.statement: $\bar\alpha(\beta,h)\equiv \inf_x \bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$, infimum over all functional order parameters $x$.

nodes.name: Interpolating partition function $\tilde Z_N(\beta,h;t;x;J)$
nodes.statement: $\tilde Z_N=\sum_\sigma \exp\bigl(\beta\sqrt{t/N}\sum_{(i,j)}J_{ij}\sigma_i\sigma_j+\beta h\sum_i\sigma_i+\beta\sqrt{1-t}\sum_{a=1}^K\sqrt{q_a-q_{a-1}}\sum_i J_i^a\sigma_i\bigr)$, with extra Gaussians $J_i^a$, $t\in[0,1]$.

nodes.name: Recursive partition functions $Z_a$ and auxiliary $\tilde\alpha_N(t)$
nodes.statement: $Z_K=\tilde Z_N$, $Z_{a-1}^{m_a}=E_a Z_a^{m_a}$ for $a=K,\dots,1$; $\tilde\alpha_N(t)=N^{-1}E_0\log Z_0$.

nodes.name: Random weights $f_a$ and tilde states $\tilde\omega_a$, $\med{\cdot}_a$
nodes.statement: $f_a=Z_a^{m_a}/E_a(Z_a^{m_a})$ (normalized, $E(f_a)=1$); $\tilde\omega_K=\omega$, $\tilde\omega_a(\cdot)=E_{a+1}\dots E_K(f_{a+1}\dots f_K\,\omega(\cdot))$; and $\med{\cdot}_a=E(f_1\dots f_a\tilde\Omega_a(\cdot))$.

nodes.name: Ground state energy density
nodes.statement: $-e_N(J,h)\equiv N^{-1}\inf_\sigma H_N(\sigma,h,J)=-\lim_{\beta\to\infty}\frac{\ln Z_N(\beta,h,J)}{\beta N}$, and $e_N(h)\equiv E(e_N(J,h))=\lim_{\beta\to\infty}\alpha_N(\beta,h)/\beta$.

nodes.name: Rescaled order parameter $\bar x$ and limiting $\tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$
nodes.statement: Given $0\le\bar m_1\le\dots\le\bar m_K$, take $x=\bar x/\beta$ in the bound; the $\beta\to\infty$ limit yields $\tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)\equiv \bar f(0,h;\bar x)-\frac{1}{2}\int_0^1 q\,\bar x(q)\,dq$, where $\bar f$ solves $(\partial_q \bar f)+\frac{1}{2}(\bar f''+\bar x(q)\bar f'^{2})=0$ with $\bar f(1,y)=|y|$.

nodes.name: p-spin Hamiltonian
nodes.statement: $H_N(\sigma,h,J)=-(p!/(2N^{p-1}))^{1/2}\sum_{(i_1,\dots,i_p)}J_{i_1\dots i_p}\sigma_{i_1}\cdots\sigma_{i_p}-h\sum_i\sigma_i$, considered for even $p$.

nodes.name: Trial auxiliary function for the p-spin model
nodes.statement: $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)\equiv \log 2 + f(0,h;x,\beta)-\frac{\beta^2}{2}\int_0^{p/2}\bar q(q)\,x(q)\,dq$, with the change of variables $2q=p\bar q^{p-1}$, $q_K=p/2$, and $f$ solving the antiparabolic equation on $[0,p/2]$ with $f(p/2,y)=\log\cosh(\beta y)$.

nodes.name: p-spin Parisi solution $\bar\alpha(\beta,h)$
nodes.statement: $\bar\alpha(\beta,h)\equiv \inf_x \bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$ for the p-spin model, with the trial function from Definition DP332.15.

nodes.name: Monotonicity and $L^1$ continuity of $f$ in $x$
nodes.statement: If $x(q)\le \bar x(q)$ for all $q\in[0,1]$ then $f(q,y;x,\beta)\le f(q,y;\bar x,\beta)$. Moreover $|f(q,y;x,\beta)-f(q,y;\bar x,\beta)|\le \frac{\beta^2}{2}\int_q^1|x(q')-\bar x(q')|\,dq'$.
assumptions: $f$ solves the antiparabolic equation with final condition $f(1,y)=\log\cosh(\beta y)$

nodes.name: Expected Parisi limit (tentative)
nodes.statement: (Expected, not proved.) In the thermodynamic limit, $\lim_{N\to\infty}N^{-1}E\log Z_N(\beta,h,J)=\bar\alpha(\beta,h)$.
assumptions: Mean field spin glass model of Section 2

nodes.name: Broken replica symmetry lower bound (main theorem)
nodes.statement: For all $\beta,h$ and any functional order parameter $x$, $N^{-1}E\log Z_N(\beta,h,J)\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$ uniformly in $N$; consequently $N^{-1}E\log Z_N\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h)$, and $\lim_N N^{-1}E\log Z_N\equiv \alpha(\beta,h)\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h)$, also $J$-almost surely.

nodes.name: $t$-derivative of $\tilde\alpha_N(t)$
nodes.statement: $\frac{d}{dt}\tilde\alpha_N(t)=-\frac{\beta^2}{4}\bigl(1-\sum_{a=0}^K(m_{a+1}-m_a)q_a^2\bigr)-\frac{\beta^2}{4}\sum_{a=0}^K(m_{a+1}-m_a)\med{(q_{12}-q_a)^2}_a$.

nodes.name: Sum rule for $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$
nodes.statement: $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)=\frac{1}{N}E\log Z_N(\beta,h;J)+\frac{\beta^2}{4}\sum_{a=0}^K(m_{a+1}-m_a)\int_0^1 \med{(q_{12}-q_a)^2}_a(t)\,dt$.
assumptions: $x$ piecewise constant of the type in DP332.5
conclusions: Sum rule expressing the gap $\bar\alpha-\alpha_N$ as a sum of nonnegative overlap variances

nodes.name: Variational bound on the ground state energy
nodes.statement: The inequalities $e_N(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$, $e_N(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h)\equiv \inf_{\bar x}\tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$, $\lim_{N\to\infty}e_N(h)\equiv e_0(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$, $e_0(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h)$ all hold.

nodes.name: Sum rule in the p-spin model
nodes.statement: $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)=\frac{1}{N}E\log Z_N(\beta,h;J)+\frac{\beta^2}{4}\sum_{a=0}^K(m_{a+1}-m_a)\int_0^1\med{q_{12}^p-p\,q_{12}\bar q_a^{p-1}+(p-1)\bar q_a^p}_a(t)\,dt+O(1/N)$.
conclusions: Sum rule with positive overlap functional and $O(1/N)$ correction

nodes.name: Broken replica symmetry bound for the p-spin model
nodes.statement: $N^{-1}E\log Z_N(\beta,h,J)\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)+O(1/N)$, hence $N^{-1}E\log Z_N\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h)+O(1/N)$, and $\alpha(\beta,h)\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h)$, $J$-almost surely.
conclusions: Lower bound on free energy in the p-spin model with $O(1/N)$ correction

nodes.name: Boundary values $\tilde\alpha_N(0)$ and $\tilde\alpha_N(1)$
nodes.statement: $\tilde\alpha_N(1)=N^{-1}E\log Z_N(\beta,h,J)$ and $\tilde\alpha_N(0)=\log 2+f(0,h;x,\beta)$.
conclusions: At $t=1$: recovers the true free energy
At $t=0$: yields the Parisi trial expression at $q=0$

nodes.name: Chain-rule expression for $\frac{d}{dt}\tilde\alpha_N(t)$
nodes.statement: $\frac{d}{dt}\tilde\alpha_N(t)=\frac{1}{N}E(f_1 f_2\cdots f_K Z_K^{-1}\partial_t Z_K)$, where $Z_K^{-1}\partial_t Z_K=\frac{\beta}{2\sqrt{tN}}\sum_{(ij)}J_{ij}\omega(\sigma_i\sigma_j)-\frac{\beta}{2\sqrt{1-t}}\sum_{a=1}^K\sqrt{q_a-q_{a-1}}\sum_i J_i^a\omega(\sigma_i)$.
conclusions: Reduction of $d\tilde\alpha_N/dt$ to a single average involving the random weights $f_a$

nodes.name: Gaussian $J$-derivatives of $\omega$ and $f_a$
nodes.statement: $\partial_{J_{ij}}\omega(\sigma_i\sigma_j)=\beta\sqrt{t/N}(1-\omega^2(\sigma_i\sigma_j))$; $\partial_{J_i^a}\omega(\sigma_i)=\beta\sqrt{1-t}\sqrt{q_a-q_{a-1}}(1-\omega^2(\sigma_i))$; $\partial_{J_{ij}}f_a=\beta\sqrt{t/N}\,m_a f_a(\tilde\omega_a-\tilde\omega_{a-1})(\sigma_i\sigma_j)$; $\partial_{J_i^a}f_b=0$ if $b<a$, $=\beta\sqrt{1-t}\sqrt{q_a-q_{a-1}}\,m_a f_a\tilde\omega_a(\sigma_i)$ if $b=a$, and $=\beta\sqrt{1-t}\sqrt{q_a-q_{a-1}}\,m_b f_b(\tilde\omega_b-\tilde\omega_{b-1})(\sigma_i)$ if $b>a$.
conclusions: Closed-form $J$-derivatives needed for integration by parts in the proof of Theorem TP332.4

nodes.name: Zero-temperature limit of $\beta^{-1}\bar\alpha(\beta,h;\bar x/\beta)$
nodes.statement: $\lim_{\beta\to\infty}\beta^{-1}\bar\alpha(\beta,h;\bar x/\beta)=\tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)\equiv \bar f(0,h;\bar x)-\frac{1}{2}\int_0^1 q\bar x(q)\,dq$, with $\bar f$ as in DP332.13.
conclusions: Existence of the $\beta\to\infty$ limit and its identification as $\tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$

nodes.name: Iterated solution of the antiparabolic equation
nodes.statement: On an interval where $x(q)=m_a$ with $m_a>0$: $f(q,y)=\frac{1}{m_a}\log\int\exp(m_a f(q_a,y+z\sqrt{q_a-q}))\,d\mu(z)$; for $m_a=0$: $f(q,y)=\int f(q_a,y+z\sqrt{q_a-q})\,d\mu(z)$.

nodes.name: Status of method: no replica trick, no cavity
nodes.statement: The method does not use the replica trick in the zero replica limit, nor the cavity method; the derivation is direct and based on a single-parameter interpolation.

nodes.name: $\med{\cdot}_a$ averages concentrate overlaps near $q_a$
nodes.statement: The averages $\med{\cdot}_a$ are designed to concentrate the overlap fluctuations $q_{12}-q_a$ around zero in the Parisi-broken regime, which is what makes the sum rule's terms have a definite sign.

nodes.name: Outlook: vanishing of correction terms
nodes.statement: The corrections in the sum rule are nonnegative; proving they vanish in the infinite volume limit would establish rigorously the validity of the Parisi broken-replica Ansatz.

nodes.name: Vanishing of overlap-fluctuation corrections in the thermodynamic limit
nodes.statement: Prove that the additional positive sum-rule terms $\sum_a(m_{a+1}-m_a)\int_0^1\med{(q_{12}-q_a)^2}_a(t)\,dt$ vanish as $N\to\infty$, which would yield the full Parisi formula.

nodes.name: Extension to other disordered systems
nodes.statement: Extend the broken-replica-symmetry interpolation method to other disordered systems, in particular mean field neural network models.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP332.1 (boundary values)
nodes.statement: At $t=1$ the auxiliary couplings $J_i^a$ disappear and $\tilde Z$ reduces to $Z$; at $t=0$ the $J_{ij}$ disappear, the $J_i^a$ contribution factorizes over sites, and the recursion DP332.10 reproduces the iterated Gaussian convolutions of (\ref{solution}) at $q=0$, $y=h$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP332.2 (chain rule for $d\tilde\alpha_N/dt$)
nodes.statement: For $a=0,\dots,K-1$, $Z_a^{-1}\partial_t Z_a=E_{a+1}(f_{a+1}Z_{a+1}^{-1}\partial_t Z_{a+1})$; iterating and using $Z_K=\tilde Z_N$ together with $\partial_t \tilde Z_N$ gives the stated formula.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP332.3 ($J$-derivatives)
nodes.statement: Direct calculation: $\partial_{J_{ij}}\omega$ and $\partial_{J_i^a}\omega$ follow from differentiating the Boltzmann state in $\tilde Z_N$; $\partial_{J_{ij}}f_a$ follows from $\partial_{J_{ij}}Z_a^{m_a}=m_a Z_a^{m_a}Z_a^{-1}\partial_{J_{ij}}Z_a$ together with the recursion $Z_a^{-1}\partial_{J_{ij}}Z_a=E_{a+1}(f_{a+1}Z_{a+1}^{-1}\partial_{J_{ij}}Z_{a+1})$ and $Z_K^{-1}\partial_{J_{ij}}Z_K=\beta\sqrt{t/N}\,\omega(\sigma_i\sigma_j)$, giving $Z_a^{-1}\partial_{J_{ij}}Z_a=\beta\sqrt{t/N}\,\tilde\omega_a(\sigma_i\sigma_j)$. The $J_i^a$ identities are analogous, using that $Z_b$ does not depend on $J_i^a$ for $b<a$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP332.4 ($t$-derivative formula)
nodes.statement: Combine Lemma LP332.2 and Lemma LP332.3 with Gaussian integration by parts on each $E(J_{ij}\dots)$ and $E(J_i^a\dots)$; the resulting sum rearranges into the stated quadratic-in-overlap expression.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP332.5 (sum rule)
nodes.statement: Integrate $d\tilde\alpha_N/dt$ from Theorem TP332.4 over $t\in[0,1]$ and apply the boundary values from Lemma LP332.1 together with the algebraic identity EP332.1 and the definition of $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP332.3 (main bound)
nodes.statement: All terms in the sum rule of Theorem TP332.5 are nonnegative because $m_{a+1}\ge m_a$, hence $N^{-1}E\log Z_N\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$. Taking the infimum over $x$ yields the bound by $\bar\alpha(\beta,h)$; combining with the existence of the thermodynamic limit (Guerra-Toninelli) gives the limiting and almost-sure statements.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma LP332.4 (zero-temperature limit)
nodes.statement: From the recursive formula EP332.2 for $f$, $\beta^{-1}f(q,y;\bar x/\beta)\to \bar f(q,y;\bar x)$ as $\beta\to\infty$, using the elementary limit $\beta^{-1}\log\cosh(\beta y)\to|y|$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem TP332.6 (ground state bound)
nodes.statement: Combine the bound $\beta^{-1}E(\ln Z_N)/N\le \beta^{-1}\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$ from Theorem TP332.3 with $x=\bar x/\beta$ and pass to the $\beta\to\infty$ limit using Lemma LP332.4 and the definition DP332.12 of $e_N(h)$.

nodes.name: Sketch of proof for Theorem TP332.7 / TP332.8 (p-spin sum rule and bound)
nodes.statement: Repeat the Section 4 procedure for the p-spin Hamiltonian DP332.14 with the modified antiparabolic interval $[0,p/2]$ and the change of variables $2q=p\bar q^{p-1}$; the only structural change is the appearance of the polynomial overlap functional $q_{12}^p-pq_{12}\bar q_a^{p-1}+(p-1)\bar q_a^p$ (still nonnegative for even $p$) and an $O(1/N)$ correction typical of p-spin models.

nodes.name: Reduce to averages of $J_{ij}\omega(\sigma_i\sigma_j)$ and $J_i^a\omega(\sigma_i)$
nodes.statement: Use Lemma LP332.2 to write $d\tilde\alpha_N/dt$ as $\frac{1}{N}E(f_1\cdots f_K Z_K^{-1}\partial_t Z_K)$, then expand $Z_K^{-1}\partial_t Z_K$ to get sums of $J_{ij}\omega(\sigma_i\sigma_j)$ and $J_i^a\omega(\sigma_i)$.

nodes.name: Apply Gaussian integration by parts
nodes.statement: Apply integration by parts on each Gaussian variable: $E(J_{ij}f_1\cdots f_K\omega(\sigma_i\sigma_j))=\sum_a E(\dots\partial_{J_{ij}}f_a\dots\omega)+E(f_1\cdots f_K\partial_{J_{ij}}\omega)$, and similarly for $J_i^a$.

nodes.name: Substitute the $J$-derivatives from Lemma LP332.3
nodes.statement: Insert the explicit expressions for $\partial_{J_{ij}}\omega$, $\partial_{J_i^a}\omega$, $\partial_{J_{ij}}f_a$ and $\partial_{J_i^a}f_b$ from Lemma LP332.3.

nodes.name: Algebraic rearrangement into telescoping overlap sum
nodes.statement: Collect the contributions, use the telescoping identity $\sum_a m_a(\tilde\omega_a-\tilde\omega_{a-1})$ together with $\med{q_{12}^2}_a$ averages, and rearrange to obtain $-\frac{\beta^2}{4}(1-\sum_a(m_{a+1}-m_a)q_a^2)-\frac{\beta^2}{4}\sum_a(m_{a+1}-m_a)\med{(q_{12}-q_a)^2}_a$.

nodes.name: Integrate $d\tilde\alpha_N/dt$ over $[0,1]$
nodes.statement: Integrate the identity of Theorem TP332.4 over $t\in[0,1]$ to express $\tilde\alpha_N(1)-\tilde\alpha_N(0)$ as a sum of overlap-variance integrals.

nodes.name: Insert boundary values from Lemma LP332.1
nodes.statement: Replace $\tilde\alpha_N(1)=N^{-1}E\log Z_N$ and $\tilde\alpha_N(0)=\log 2+f(0,h;x,\beta)$.

nodes.name: Apply identity EP332.1 and definition of $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$
nodes.statement: Use $\frac{1}{2}(1-\sum_a(m_{a+1}-m_a)q_a^2)=\int_0^1 q\,x(q)\,dq$ and the definition $\bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)=\log 2+f(0,h;x,\beta)-\frac{\beta^2}{2}\int q\,x\,dq$ to obtain the sum rule.

nodes.name: Sign of sum-rule terms
nodes.statement: Since $m_{a+1}\ge m_a$ and each $\med{(q_{12}-q_a)^2}_a\ge 0$, every correction in the sum rule of Theorem TP332.5 is nonnegative.

nodes.name: Drop nonnegative corrections to obtain the bound
nodes.statement: Discarding the nonnegative correction yields $N^{-1}E\log Z_N(\beta,h,J)\le \bar\alpha(\beta,h;x)$, uniformly in $N$.

nodes.name: Take infimum over $x$ and pass to the thermodynamic limit
nodes.statement: Take $\inf_x$ to obtain the bound by $\bar\alpha(\beta,h)$, and combine with the existence of $\lim_N N^{-1}\log Z_N$ from \cite{GTthermo} to obtain the limit and the $J$-almost sure statement.

nodes.name: Apply the main bound with $x=\bar x/\beta$
nodes.statement: From Theorem TP332.3, $\beta^{-1}E(\ln Z_N)/N\le \beta^{-1}\bar\alpha(\beta,h;\bar x/\beta)$, valid for $\beta$ large enough that $\bar m_K\le\beta$.

nodes.name: Pass to the $\beta\to\infty$ limit using Lemma LP332.4
nodes.statement: By Lemma LP332.4, the right-hand side converges to $\tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$; the left-hand side converges to $e_N(h)$ by Definition DP332.12, yielding $e_N(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$.

nodes.name: Take infimum and $N\to\infty$ limit
nodes.statement: Take $\inf_{\bar x}$ to get $e_N(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h)$, then pass to $N\to\infty$ to obtain $e_0(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h;\bar x)$ and $e_0(h)\le \tilde\alpha_N(h)$.
